enabled.title: Show minimap
enabled.description: Display the CodeGlance Pro minimap beside text editors.

pixelsPerLine.title: Pixels per line
pixelsPerLine.description: Height of each logical/visual line row in the minimap (2, 3, or 4 px).

cleanMode.title: Clean mode
cleanMode.description: Draw crisp block glyphs instead of noisy character sub-dots.

renderMode.title: Color mode
renderMode.description: Color tokens from editor syntax/semantic highlighting, a muted neutral tint, or the IDE accent color.

viewportStyle.title: Viewport indicator style
viewportStyle.description: How the currently visible editor region is framed inside the minimap.

showHoverLens.title: Show hover code lens
showHoverLens.description: Show a docked, common-indent-trimmed code preview when hovering over the minimap.

hoverLensLines.title: Hover code lens lines
hoverLensLines.description: Number of lines shown inside the hover code lens preview (5–21).

showVcsChanges.title: Show VCS change markers
showVcsChanges.description: Draw added, modified, and deleted Git change bars along the left edge.

showProblems.title: Show problem markers
showProblems.description: Draw error, warning, and weak-warning stripes along the right edge.

showSelections.title: Show caret and selections
showSelections.description: Highlight the active caret line and selected ranges in the minimap.

showRegionComments.title: Show region section markers
showRegionComments.description: Highlight `// region <name>` and `// MARK: <name>` dividers inside the minimap.

autoHideShortFiles.title: Auto-hide for short files (lines)
autoHideShortFiles.description: Hide minimap rendering when a file has fewer than this many lines (0 disables auto-hide).

maxLines.title: Max lines to render
maxLines.description: Skip per-line token drawing in very large files above this line count while keeping viewport, problems, and VCS bars active.
